results.title: Exploratory vs. confirmatory research | Prolific
results.content: confirmatory research: which is right for your study? #### What is exploratory research? Exploratory research is especially useful if you’re studying a topic that doesn’t have a long history of empirical research behind it. Exploratory research is more open than confirmatory research. #### What is confirmatory research? This may have been gathered through exploratory research. In exploratory research, you’re gathering data without trying to establish a particular theory. In confirmatory research, your goal is to find evidence for (or against) a hypothesis. Confirmatory research has stricter boundaries than exploratory research. ### Why it's dangerous to confuse exploratory and confirmatory research. Exploratory and confirmatory research can inform one another in positive ways. If you mix up these two forms of research, you risk presenting exploratory findings as confirmatory. They might do some exploratory research to discover the drinks these students enjoy. Want to create a research study? Whether you choose exploratory or confirmatory research, you'll always need high quality data.
